types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the workflow execution.

types.name: execution
types.description: The execution details of the workflow.

children.name: steps
children.description:
The details of the workflow execution's steps.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the step's details.

children.name: invoke
children.description: The invoke function of the step.

children.name: compensate
children.description: The compensate function of the step.

children.name: startedAt
children.description: The date the step was started.

types.name: context
types.description:
The context of the workflow execution.
This includes the data, errors and the output of the step and compensation functions of the workflow execution.

children.name: data
children.description: The data of the workflow execution.

children.name: invoke
children.description:
The details of the invocation of the workflow execution's steps.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the step's details.

These details are only included for steps that have their `saveResponse` property set to `true`.

children.name: payload
children.description: The payload or input of the workflow execution.

children.name: compensate
children.description:
The output of the compensation function of the workflow execution.
The key is the step's ID, and the value is the compensation function's output.

These details are only included for steps that have their `saveResponse` property set to `true`.

children.name: errors
children.description: The errors of the workflow execution.

children.name: action
children.description: The ID of the action that failed.

children.name: handlerType
children.description: The type of the handler that failed. It can be `invoke` or `compensate`.

types.name: state
types.description: The state of the workflow execution.

types.name: created_at
types.description: The date the workflow execution was created.

types.name: updated_at
types.description: The date the workflow execution was updated.

types.name: deleted_at
types.description: The date the workflow execution was deleted.
